n: CMU virtual robot courses (Virtual SPIKE Prime and virtual robot)
t: Browser robotics courses with a simulated robot that need no hardware.
steps: Find the courses on the CS-STEM Network and read the index page.
Ask the vendor for current prices.
Buy seats through the store or by purchase order.
Assign seats to students through CS2N groups.
Open the first unit in Chrome and test it.
Read the CS2N privacy information before students sign in.
